title: Re-vendor eidolon-plugins into Minerva
what: After you push P1, or explicitly allow vendoring the local commit, copy that upstream commit over Minerva/eidolon-plugins as a plain snapshot with no hand edits. Update the VENDORED.md row: revision, date, and a note on the snapshot max.
tests: `bash eidolon-plugins/tests/jev/pin.sh --check eidolon-plugins/jev` passes. `diff -r` against the upstream commit (excluding .git) is empty.
risk: Vendoring a commit that is not on GitHub breaks the VENDORED.md promise. Wait for the push.
